title: The sprint runner measures its own work as redacted operational events
goal: kb/_querylog/ops/ holds redacted, gated, closed-vocabulary rows of what land, the sync gate, tests, refused dones, CI reads, intake runs, subagents and sprint closes did and took; the existing distill push delivers them; querylog.py export prints them with the query log in one record format; the weekly digest and the sprint review report them; the autopilot reads them to find stalled work, orphaned processes and its own limits.
